name: garmin-dynamic-mcp
description: Read-only access to your Garmin Connect data (activities, sleep, HRV, steps, Body Battery and more).
long_description: Ask Claude about your own Garmin data. Runs on your computer with your own Garmin Personal API key (create one at https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken). Read-only; the endpoint catalog follows Garmin's API. Not affiliated with Garmin.

garmin_api_key.title: Garmin Personal API key
garmin_api_key.description: Create it at https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken and paste it here. Claude Desktop stores it securely.
